# LL-31  Billing: month end, discounts, refunds, receipts

Plese review the branch aginst this ticket. The ticket was writen in a hurry.

1. Totels on an invoice must be exact to the cent, no roundng drift.
2. The invoice list for a month must inclued everything issued on the last day too.
3. Costumers who buy 10 or more units of one item get 10% off that line.
4. Stock must never go below zero, even when many orders arive at the same moment.
5. A customer can only see and download their own invoices, never anybody elses.
6. Only finnance staff may wave a late fee. Other staff must be refused.
7. A declined card is final: do not try agian, tell the customer at once.
8. After a payment worked, a receipt email must be qeued for the customer.
9. Fees for the accounts of the kind that is not those from before shall go as the other way unless it is so when above, as was agreed with the one that asked.
10. The late fee is 2% of the invoice total once the invoice is past its due date.
